$comment: v2.9 — identical frame WIDTH and HEIGHT on every letter; R/S/C letter style; waist flush; C clipboard back

sticker_frame.shape: axis-aligned rounded rectangle, IDENTICAL size on every letter R I A S E C
sticker_frame.aspect_ratio: 780:640 — never wider, never narrower, never taller, never shorter
sticker_frame.placement: centered on canvas — left/right margins exactly 122px each, top/bottom margins exactly 192px each
sticker_frame.height_lock: frame outer height is exactly 640px on ALL letters including A — A must not be shorter or taller
sticker_frame.width_lock: frame outer width is exactly 780px on ALL letters including A — A must not be wider
forbidden: frame border colored with letter accent (except E coral)

large_letter_style.gold_reference: match letters R, S, and C exactly — rounded bold sans
large_letter_style.font: bold rounded sans-serif block letter — NOT serif, NOT slab-serif, NOT blocky square, NOT thin
large_letter_style.treatment: solid fill + thin white inner offset stroke + thick dark outer outline #2D2D2D
large_letter_style.height: large letter height about 420px — same on every sticker, fills most of left half vertically
large_letter_style.placement: left half of frame interior, vertically centered between top and bottom inner borders
forbidden: blocky square A or E different from R/S/C

character_scale.height: character head near top inner border (~24px padding), waist flush to bottom inner border — fills full frame height on every letter
character_scale.width: character occupies right half, same visual scale on every letter

corner_badge.content: matching capital letter, same sans style as large letter

global_rules.character_style: KursoKo questionnaire unDraw-inspired student: thin 2px outline #2D2D2D on character only, flat fills, minimal solid black dot eyes, natural hair colors, simplified hands
global_rules.framing: waist-up bust only — head through mid-torso; bottom of torso and props flush to and cropped by the INNER bottom border; no paper gap under waist
global_rules.prop_density: one hero prop + at most one support prop, chest/hand level only
global_rules.facing: character angles slightly inward-left toward the large letter
forbidden: white sticker cutout around the character
short wide frame especially letter A
clipboard checklist facing the viewer on letter C
